generations.text: Yara Alvarez contacted support because the Aero 2 shows a blank screen on boot since 2026-03-15. It is a Medium priority case and the status is currently Working. A callback is scheduled for 2026-04-04. The customer confirmed order ORD-85132 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Returns of the Aero 2 need an RMA number within 30 days. A replacement unit was shipped under RMA-50884 on 2026-04-08. The customer seems satisfied with the proposed next step.
